what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee spent nearly the whole meeting scoring Fire Department job descriptions with a department head, covering EMT, firefighter, paramedic, captain and officer roles.
Speakers noted a firefighter paramedic could be graded at the same pay as a captain or higher, which affects where each position is placed.
Grade placement and step were discussed in connection with collective bargaining and the salary schedule, and grade numbers were listed for EMT and captain.
The meeting closed on a public safety support position, certification wording and when to hold the next meeting.
No vote or decision can be confirmed; the captions are too garbled to hear any outcome, including on taking items out of order.

why_it_matters: The point scores set the pay grade for fire and EMS jobs, which flows into the personnel line of the town budget and into what the town must bargain over.
Because no outcome is audible in the recording, residents cannot tell from it whether any grade was actually set.
watch_next: The next Personnel Committee meeting, whose timing was discussed at the end but is not audible in the minutes.
